arxiv-2103-06401.title: Spaser and Optical Amplification Conditions in Graphene-Coated Active Wires
arxiv-2103-06401.creator: Leila Prelat, Mauro Cuevas, Nicolás Passarelli, Raúl Bustos Marún, Ricardo Depine
arxiv-2103-06401.description: Abstract This work analyzes the optical properties of a localized surface plasmon (LSP) spaser made of a dielectric active wire coated with a graphene monolayer. Our theoretical results, obtained by using rigorous electromagnetic methods, illustrate the non-radiative transfer between the active medium and the localized surface plasmons of the graphene.

arxiv-2204-13313.title: The equivariant coarse Baum-Connes conjecture for actions by a-T-menable groups Thanks: Both of the authors are supported by NSFC11871342.
arxiv-2204-13313.creator: Benyin Fu and Jiawen Zhang
arxiv-2204-13313.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Benyin Fu and Jiawen Zhang. The equivariant coarse Baum-Connes conjecture was firstly introduced by Roe [ 29 ] as a unified way to approach both the Baum-Connes conjecture and its coarse counterpart. In this paper, we prove that if an a-T-menable group Γ \Gamma acts properly and isometrically on a bounded geometry metric space X X with controlled distortion such that the quotient space X / Γ X/\Gamma is coarsely embeddable, then the equivariant coarse Baum-Connes conjecture holds for this action.

arxiv-2206-08290.title: Multi-path fading and interference mitigation with Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
arxiv-2206-08290.creator: Jean Baptiste Gros, Geoffroy Lerosey, Fabrice Lemoult, Mir Lodro, Steve Greedy, Gabriele Gradoni
arxiv-2206-08290.description: Abstract We exploit multi-path fading propagation to improve both the signal-to-interference-plus-noise-ratio and the stability of wireless communications within electromagnetic environments that support rich multipath propagation. Quasi-passive propagation control with multiple binary reconfigurable intelligent surfaces is adopted to control the stationary waves supported by a metallic cavity hosting a software-defined radio link.

arxiv-2210-09357.title: Gravitational-wave imprints of compact and galactic-scale environments in extreme-mass-ratio binaries
arxiv-2210-09357.creator: Kyriakos Destounis 1,2,3 , Arun Kulathingal 3 , Kostas D. Kokkotas 3,4 and Georgios O. Papadopoulos 4
arxiv-2210-09357.description: Abstract Circumambient and galactic-scale environments are intermittently present around black holes, especially those residing in active galactic nuclei. As supermassive black holes impart energy on their host galaxy, so the galactic environment affects the geodesic dynamics of solar-mass objects around supermassive black holes and subsequently the gravitational waves emitted from such non-vacuum extreme-mass-ratio binaries.

arxiv-2212-02080.title: The glueball spectrum with N f = 4 N_{f}=4 light fermions
arxiv-2212-02080.creator: Michael Teper
arxiv-2212-02080.description: Abstract We investigate the glueball spectrum for N f = 4 N_{f}=4 fermions corresponding to low pion masses of m π ∼ 250 m_{\pi}\sim 250 MeV. We do so by making use of configurations produced with maximally twisted fermions within the framework of the Extended Twisted Mass Collaboration (ETMC).

arxiv-2303-06115.title: Gravitomagnetism and galaxy rotation curves: a cautionary tale
arxiv-2303-06115.creator: A.N. Lasenby, M.P. Hobson, W.E.V. Barker
arxiv-2303-06115.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A.N. Lasenby, M.P. Hobson, W.E.V. Barker. We investigate recent claims that gravitomagnetic effects in linearised general relativity can explain flat and rising rotation curves, such as those observed in galaxies, without the need for dark matter.

arxiv-2402-10701.title: Does Twinning Vehicular Networks Enhance Their Performance in Dense Areas?
arxiv-2402-10701.creator: Sarah Al-Shareeda 1 , Sema F. Oktug 1 , Yusuf Yaslan 1 , Gokhan Yurdakul 2 , and Berk Canberk 3
arxiv-2402-10701.description: Abstract This paper investigates the potential of Digital Twins (DTs) to enhance network performance in densely populated urban areas, specifically focusing on vehicular networks. The study comprises two phases. In Phase I, we utilize traffic data and AI clustering to identify critical locations, particularly in crowded urban areas with high accident rates.

arxiv-2409-13552.title: Extraspecial pairs in the multiply-laced root systems and calculating structure constants
arxiv-2409-13552.creator: Rafael Stekolshchik
arxiv-2409-13552.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rafael Stekolshchik. The notions of special and extraspecial pairs of roots were introduced by Carter for calculating structure constants, [ Ca72 ] . Let { r , s } \{r,s\} be a special pair of roots for which the structure constant N ⁡ ( r , s ) N(r,s) is sought, and let { r 1 , s 1 } \{r_{1},s_{1}\} be the extraspecial pair of roots corresponding to { r , s } \{r,s\} .

arxiv-2410-14968.title: AugInsert: Learning Robust Visual-Force Policies via Data Augmentation for Object Assembly Tasks
arxiv-2410-14968.creator: Ryan Diaz, Adam Imdieke, Vivek Veeriah, Karthik Desingh
arxiv-2410-14968.description: Abstract Operating in unstructured environments like households requires robotic policies that are robust to out-of-distribution conditions. Although much work has been done in evaluating robustness for visuomotor policies, the robustness evaluation of a multisensory approach that includes force-torque sensing remains largely unexplored.

arxiv-2503-10424.title: Plane curve singularities via divides Thanks: This publication has been partially funded by the grant (holded by the second author) RYC2022-035158-I, funded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by the FSE+
arxiv-2503-10424.creator: Norbert A’Campo and Pablo Portilla Cuadrado
arxiv-2503-10424.description: Abstract . Generic relative immersions of compact one-manifolds in the closed unit disk, i.e. divides, provide a powerful combinatorial framework, and allow a topological construction of fibered classical links, for which the monodromy diffeomorphism is explicitly given as a product of Dehn twists.

arxiv-2503-12996.title: Semi-Streaming Algorithms for Graph Property Certification
arxiv-2503-12996.creator: Avinandan Das, Pierre Fraigniaud, Ami Paz, Adi Rosén
arxiv-2503-12996.description: Abstract We introduce the certification of solutions to graph problems when access to the input is restricted. This topic has received a lot of attention in the distributed computing setting, and we introduce it here in the context of streaming algorithms, where the input is too large to be stored in memory.

pmc-10537079.title: Validation of a short version of the high-fidelity simulation satisfaction scale in nursing students
pmc-10537079.creator: Alejandro Martínez-Arce, Julián Rodríguez-Almagro, Esperanza Vélez-Vélez, Paloma Rodríguez-Gómez, Alberto Tovar-Reinoso, Antonio Hernández-Martínez
pmc-10537079.description: BackgroundClinical simulation provides a practical and effective learning method during the undergraduate education of health professions. Currently there is only one validated scale in Spanish to assess nursing students’ satisfaction with the use of high-fidelity simulation, therefore, our objective is to validate a brief version of this scale in undergraduate nursing students with or without clinical experience.

pmc-11445887.title: A novel anti-CD47 antibody with therapeutic potential for NK/T-cell lymphoma
pmc-11445887.creator: Liping Qin, Yajun Li, Ruolan Zeng, Yizi He, Xiaoyan Chen, Ling Xiao, Hui Zhou
pmc-11445887.description: NK/T-cell lymphoma (NKTCL) is a rare type of non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL). Although L-asparaginase-based chemotherapy has significantly improved survival in early-stage patients, the prognosis is poor in advanced and relapsed or refractory patients. CD47 is a promising target for cancer immunotherapy.

pmc-11476005.title: Prognostic Impact of HER2 Low Status in Male Breast Cancer: Prospective Cohort Analysis
pmc-11476005.creator: Atanas Ignatov, Sina Lempfer, József Mészáros, Holm Eggemann, Carlos S Moreno
pmc-11476005.description: Simple SummaryMale breast cancer (MBC) is a rare condition, and the role of low HER2 expression (HER2 low) is not well understood. In this prospective study, 870 MBC patients treated between May 2009 and June 2023 were evaluated to investigate the prognostic significance of HER2 low status.

pmc-11511728.title: Development of microflow ultra high performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry metabolomic assays for analysis of mammalian biofluids
pmc-11511728.creator: Annie J Harwood-Stamper, Caroline A Rowland, Warwick B Dunn
pmc-11511728.description: Introduction and objectivesThe application of untargeted metabolomics assays using ultra high performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (UHPLC-MS) to study metabolism in biological systems including humans is rapidly increasing. In some of these studies there is a requirement to collect and analyse low sample volumes of biofluids (e.g. tear fluid) or low cell and tissue mass samples (e.g. tissue needle biopsies).

pmc-11555346.title: A putative cAMP-binding protein in Trypanosoma brucei cooperates with FLAM3 to promote flagellar connection and cell morphogenesis
pmc-11555346.creator: Qing Zhou, Phu Van Nguyen, Ziyin Li
pmc-11555346.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Trypanosoma brucei is a flagellated parasitic protozoan, and within the insect vector the parasite transitions from the trypomastigote form to the epimastigote form by repositioning its mitochondrial genome and relocating the flagellum. The mechanisms underlying such morphology changes are still poorly understood, but several flagellum-localized proteins are involved in this process by modulating the flagellum attachment zone (FAZ) that adheres the flagellum to the cell membrane. We report here a putative cAMP-binding protein named cAMP-BP1, which promotes flagellar connection and morphology transition.

pmc-12374386.title: Taurine, Sirtuin-1 and TNF- α levels in different aged adults with periodontitis: a pilot study
pmc-12374386.creator: Hadi Sayedyousef, Onur Yilmaz, Cagla Ozturk, Becen Demir, Hilal Uslu Toygar, Nur Balci
pmc-12374386.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAging is a progressive decline in physiological & immunological functions, leading to an increased risk of chronic diseases. Taurine is a semi-essential amino acid, reduces inflammation by apoptosis, and oxidative stress by lowering inflammatory factors and decreases oxidative stress.

pmc-12837438.title: Non-housing assets and all-cause mortality in middle-aged and older Chinese adults: a National cohort study
pmc-12837438.creator: Yuanyuan Qin, Biheng Feng, Qingjiang Cai, Liuyun Huang, Mingjie Xie, Ling Li, Debin Huang
pmc-12837438.description: BackgroundFinancial resources beyond housing may influence survival in later life. Given China’s rapid population aging and high home ownership, focusing on non-housing assets can clarify wealth–health links. We therefore examined the association between total non-housing assets and all-cause mortality among Chinese middle-aged and older adults.MethodsA nationwide cohort of 12,670 adults (aged 45–85) was established using the harmonized CHARLS dataset (2011–2018).

pmc-13212708.title: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial to assess the postprandial dose-dependent effects of wild blueberries on metabolic and cognitive outcomes following a high-carbohydrate breakfast
pmc-13212708.creator: Lucy R. Ellis, Dominic O’Connor, Haseena Khan, Louise Dye, Christine Boesch
pmc-13212708.description: PurposeDespite equivocal human study data, anthocyanin-rich blueberries are associated with positive glycaemic effects which could benefit satiety and other cardiometabolic outcomes. The objective of this study was to examine the dose-dependent effects of freeze-dried wild blueberries on postprandial glucose response simultaneously with changes in satiety, blood pressure and cognitive function.MethodsTwenty-four healthy participants (F = 22), mean BMI 22.

pmc-13445157.creator: Kevin He, Xiangeng Fang, Yubo Shao, Nicholas Hartman, John D. Kalbfleisch

pmc-13451336.title: Template guided versus freehand rod bending in spinal deformity surgery: a feasibility study
pmc-13451336.creator: L Bättig, A R Dixon, E Molero Hidalgo, N Hejrati, F C Stengel, F Corr, T Schöfl, L Feuerstein, N A Pogonitz, S Singh, B Martens, M N Stienen, Stefan Motov
pmc-13451336.description: Spinal deformity correction relies on osteotomies and precisely contoured rods, which are critical for restoring sagittal alignment. Inaccurate rod bending may compromise alignment and increase the risk of junctional failure. This feasibility study compares the accuracy of template-guided versus freehand rod contouring in a simulated environment. Using SurgiMap® software, 12 double-curved rods were designed from full-spine radiographs.

pmc-13536512.title: The Ties That Rhyme: Duality in Symbolic and Structural Networks of Grime Music
pmc-13536512.creator: Tom R. Leppard, Andrew P. Davis
pmc-13536512.description: Do birds of a feather really sing together? Musicians face two competing pressures in the pursuit of success: conforming to genre norms to meet audience expectations and distinguishing themselves to attract the attention of listeners. These opposing logics may shape how artists choose their collaborators.

pmc-13646187.title: Investigating the Relationship Between Estrogen Replacement Therapy and Postoperative Complications Following Single-Level Lumbar Fusion: A Propensity Matched Analysis
pmc-13646187.creator: Kyle B. Stump, Alec M. Giakas, Gregorio Baek, Mitchell K. Ng, Andrew P. Alvarez, Alan S. Hilibrand, Alexander R. Vaccaro, Gregory D. Schroeder, Christopher K. Kepler
pmc-13646187.description: Study DesignRetrospective Cohort.ObjectivesThe objective of this study was to investigate the relationship between preoperative estrogen replacement therapy and postoperative complications following single level lumbar fusion.MethodsThe TriNetX Research Network was queried for menopausal patients aged ≥ 50 years who underwent single level lumbar fusion. Patients issued ERT within the 12-month preoperative period were separated from patients with no documented ERT use.
